text: Independent component implementations model rendering presence separately from animation completion.
Independent animation implementations include safeguards or regression cases for stale exit completion after re-entry.
Independent web motion implementations subscribe to media-query changes and remove the listener during cleanup.
Inspected motion hooks use both snapshot and change-subscription approaches, so an API name alone does not establish live preference behavior.
Independent agent motion projects include supporting verification guidance that asks agents to inspect rendered moments.
Independent component implementations explicitly handle canceled animations or canceled leave results before removing presence.
